description: Source code for the BrowserContext class in Playwright, managing browser contexts, including page handling, routing, event handling, and HAR recording.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context in Playwright, managing pages, routing, events, and other context-specific operations.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within the browser context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser context, releasing resources and saving HAR if configured.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves the storage state (cookies, localStorage, etc.) of the context.

methods.name: setStorageState
methods.description: Sets the storage state for the context from a file or object.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Adds a route to intercept network requests matching a URL pattern.

methods.name: unroute
methods.description: Removes a route matching a URL pattern.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to occur within the context.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for operations.

methods.name: newCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session for a page or frame.
